turns.prompt:
Create the library overdue report as of 2026-10-20. A loan in library/loans.csv is overdue if due is strictly earlier than that date and it has no row in library/returns.csv with returned on or before 2026-10-20. A return after the cutoff does not close the loan for this report. Each loan has at most one return. For each borrower with overdue loans, report the number and the maximum calendar-day difference (cutoff minus due) among those loans. Write summary.csv with header borrower,overdue_books,max_overdue_days, sorted by borrower in ASCII order. Omit borrowers with zero overdue loans.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.

files.summary.csv:
borrower,overdue_books,max_overdue_days
